author: Rubikscrafter
body: I have the video of someone monument blocking/stealing from me on Justice II. I unfortunately can't upload it to Youtube because I was listening to copyrighted material while I was playing, and I started recording to record the mon blocker. And the option to take the song out on YouTube doesn't work very well. What can I do?

replies.body: Edit the video so that there is no sound. That should work.

replies.body: You can easily download one on the internet. Try to get some recommendations from others, as some video editors can be potentially filled with malware, etc.

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
If you have a PC, "Windows Live Movie Maker" should be pre-installed. If you have a MAC, "iMovie" should be pre-installed.

Search your computer to see if you have these programs.

Also if you can, make sure the player wasn't already punished.
